integrity: Analytic proof supported by an embedded computational checker; computational tests do not prove infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: Fixed k >= 4 with unit hyperedge simplex weights; width only in Haar-random directions. Exact limit law relies on standard U-statistic theory; unindexed prior results may cover this comparison. No independent validation.
title: A hub-induced non-Gaussian width law for uniform hypergraphic polytopes
